cliper_lite_status: EXCLUDED_FROM_V1 (Per Final Design-Gate Correction 1: zero learned models in V1 baseline suite)
test_set_quarantine_policy: STRICT_FORBIDDEN (No baseline calculation may access the 2024-2026 quarantined test partition)

baseline_a_persistence.name: Persistence Baseline
baseline_a_persistence.description: Assumes zero net intensity change over 24 hours. Primary scientific benchmark against which ML skill is measured.

baseline_b_damped_trend.name: Damped Kinematic Trend Baseline
baseline_b_damped_trend.alpha_provenance: PRE-DECLARED HEURISTIC (Represents 50% continuation of past 12-hour kinematic intensity change rate over the subsequent 24 hours to prevent unphysical runaway extrapolation; frozen prior to validation comparison without tuning)
baseline_b_damped_trend.trend_derivation_rule: Use dvmax_12h if available; if dvmax_12h is NaN, fall back to 2.0 * dvmax_6h; if both NaN, trend = 0.0

clipping_policy.min_bound_provenance: IMD Best Track standard meteorological depression floor (lowest recognized cyclonic disturbance classification in RSMC New Delhi tracks is 17 kt; 15 kt represents low-end depression/deep depression boundary)
clipping_policy.max_bound_provenance: North Indian Ocean physical maximum intensity ceiling for Super Cyclonic Storms (e.g. 1999 Odisha cyclone, SuCS Amphan 2020, Mocha 2023 peak gusts/estimates)

partition_test_2024_2026.access_rule: FORBIDDEN (Test set metrics will only be evaluated once after entire ML training pipeline is frozen and authorized)
